title: ID0388416-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2/R5 313059216002] Screws popped out of filter frame
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The screw on the top RHS filter frame popped out of the frame when I removed the filter. I suspect it was not properly rivetted to the frame
Root cause: Manufacturing defect
Solution:  replacement cover provided to customer
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: 6/27/2025

Hello again Vaishnavi,
Thank you for awaiting,
We’ve consulted with a multidisciplinary team [PC, QM, MF and supplier],
Here’s the findings and suggested containment action:
To contain the issue, it should be aligned with LPZ since they’re the ones who provide spare parts, but to provide more agility on this we have some stock of this unit [8EM5905-0AA00-1AA4] and we can send it directly.
We understand that this route is quicker. Does this seem ok to you? If so, let me know the address.
We started the root cause analysis to apply corrective actions (if applicable from SCM side) and therefore we thank you for informing us about this issue.
In manufacturing process, the intervention on this side is very slim so the possibility of being incorrectly riveted by supplier seems reasonable, but I reinforce it is not yet reproduced(meaning the cause is not confirmed).
We may ask further questions to you in the future to help us with the root cause analysis [RCA], but so far no further subject,
Thanks in advance,
